en: Sepia-toned historic postcard showing a central square bordered by traditional European townhouses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. In the middle stands a statue of a man in military dress on a pedestal labeled "ALBERT." The caption at the top reads "Pulsnitz i. Sa." and "König Albert-Denkmal auf dem Neumarkt." Shop signs on the surrounding buildings include "Schuhwarenhaus, Freischütz Max Hommig" and others.
